table.retrieve:
SELECT  
	SaleType = 1, 
	itemname =max(item.Name),
	users.username, 
	salecat=max(saleledger.salecatcode),
	saleledger.custcode,
	headerno = dbo.saleledger.headerno,
	customer=(select name from accounts where acccode=saleledger.custcode),
	dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode,   
	dbo.saleledger.date,   
	dbo.saleledger.discperc,   
	dbo.saleledger.misccharges,   
	dbo.saleledger.flatdisc,   
	dbo.saleledger.salestax,   
	dbo.saleledger.custcode,   
	dbo.saleledger.remarks,   
	dbo.saledetail.icode,   
	gcode=max(dbo.saledetail.gcode), 
	cashtendered=saleledger.cashtendered,
	cashreceived=saleledger.cashcharged,
	cashback=saleledger.cashback,
	CardsCharged=ISNULL((select isnull(sum(CW.amount),0) from cashierwindow CW where CW.saleinvcode=saleledger.saleinvcode), 0),
	Id        = MAX(dbo.saledetail.IDENTITYCOL),  
	looseqty  = sum(saledetail.looseqty), 
	packqty   = sum(saledetail.packqty), 
	packunits = saledetail.packunits, 
	saleprice = saledetail.saleprice, 
	rate      = max(saledetail.rate),
	salestax  = max(saledetail.salestax),   
	discperc  = saledetail.discperc, 
	customername='                                  '  ,
	itemflatdisc  = max(saledetail.itemflatdisc),
	aliasname=item.customicode,
	machinename=',' +  max(saleledger.machinename),
	reprintcounter=max(dbo.saleledger.reprintingcounter),
	SrBufferInvCode=dbo.saleledger.SRBufferInvCode,
	InvTotal = dbo.saleledger.InvTotal,
	altersaleinvcode= dbo.saleledger.altersaleinvcode,
	associatedamt= 0.00,
	serverdate=getdate()
FROM 
	dbo.saleledger,   
	dbo.saledetail,  
	item,
	Users 
WHERE 
	( dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode = :ra_InvCode ) AND
	( dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode = dbo.saledetail.saleinvcode ) AND 
	( saleLedger.SalesManCode = users.userCode ) and
	( saledetail.icode = item.icode )
GROUP BY 
	saleledger.saleinvcode, 
	saleledger.srbufferinvcode,
	saleledger.date, 
	saleledger.custcode, 
	saleledger.discperc, 
	saleledger.flatdisc, 
	saleledger.misccharges, 
	saleledger.headerno,
	saleledger.salestax, 
	saleledger.remarks, 
	dbo.saleledger.InvTotal,
	dbo.saleledger.altersaleinvcode,
	saleledger.cashcharged,
	saleledger.cashtendered,
	saleledger.cashback,
	saledetail.icode,
	saledetail.packunits, 
	saledetail.saleprice, 
	saledetail.discperc, 
	item.name,
	item.icode,
	item.printable,
	item.customicode,
	users.username
UNION ALL
SELECT	 
	SaleType = 1,
	itemname = ISNULL((SELECT '*' + MachineName FROM SaleLedger WHERE SaleInvCode = AssocSaleInvCode) + ' (' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(AssocSaleInvCode))) + ')', ''),
	users.username, 
	salecat=saleledger.salecatcode,
	saleledger.custcode,
	headerno = dbo.saleledger.headerno,
	customer=(select name from accounts where acccode=saleledger.custcode),
	dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode,   
	dbo.saleledger.date,   
	dbo.saleledger.discperc,   
	dbo.saleledger.misccharges,   
	dbo.saleledger.flatdisc,   
	dbo.saleledger.salestax,   
	dbo.saleledger.custcode,   
	dbo.saleledger.remarks,   
	icode=NULL,   
	gcode=NULL, 
	cashtendered=saleledger.cashtendered,
	cashreceived=saleledger.cashcharged,
	cashback=saleledger.cashback,
	CardsCharged=ISNULL((select isnull(sum(CW.amount),0) from cashierwindow CW where CW.saleinvcode=saleledger.saleinvcode), 0),
	Id        = 999999999999,  
	looseqty  = 0, 
	packqty   = 0, 
	packunits = 0, 
	saleprice = 0, 
	rate      = 0,
	salestax  = 0,   
	discperc  = 0, 
	customername='                                  '  ,
	itemflatdisc  = 0,
	aliasname=NULL,
	machinename=',' + saleledger.machinename,
	reprintcounter=dbo.saleledger.reprintingcounter,
	SrBufferInvCode=dbo.saleledger.SRBufferInvCode,
	InvTotal = dbo.saleledger.InvTotal,
	altersaleinvcode= dbo.saleledger.altersaleinvcode,
	associatedamt= DBO.fn_GetSaleInvTotal(L.AssocSaleInvCode),
	serverdate=getdate()
FROM 
	dbo.saleledger,   
	AssocSaleInvList L, 
	Users
WHERE 
	( dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode = :ra_InvCode ) AND
	( dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode = L.saleinvcode ) AND 
	( saleLedger.SalesManCode = users.userCode )
UNION ALL
SELECT  
	SaleType = 2,
	itemname =max(item.Name),
	/*itemname = case printable when  0  then ltrim(str(item.icode)) + ' Counter Sale'   else item.name end, */
	users.username, 
	salecat=max(srbufferledger.srcatcode),
	srbufferledger.custcode,
	headerno = dbo.srbufferledger.headerno,
	customer=(select name from accounts where acccode=srbufferledger.custcode),
	dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode,   
	dbo.srbufferledger.date,   
	dbo.srbufferledger.discperc,   
	dbo.srbufferledger.misccharges,   
	dbo.srbufferledger.flatdisc,   
	dbo.srbufferledger.salestax,   
	dbo.srbufferledger.custcode,   
	dbo.srbufferledger.remarks,   
	dbo.srbufferdetail.icode,   
	dbo.srbufferdetail.gcode, 
	cashtendered=saleledger.cashtendered,
	cashreceived=saleledger.cashcharged,
	cashback=saleledger.cashback,
	CardsCharged=ISNULL((select isnull(sum(CW.amount),0) from cashierwindow CW where CW.saleinvcode=saleledger.saleinvcode), 0),
	Id        = MAX(dbo.srbufferdetail.IDENTITYCOL),  
	looseqty  = - sum(srbufferdetail.looseqty), 
	packqty   = 0.000, 
	packunits = max(srbufferdetail.packunits), 
	saleprice = max(srbufferdetail.srprice), 
	rate      = max(srbufferdetail.srprice),
	salestax  = max(srbufferdetail.salestax),   
	discperc  = max(srbufferdetail.discperc), 
	customername='                                  '  ,
	itemflatdisc  = 0.00,
	aliasname=item.customicode,
	machinename=',' +  max(srbufferledger.machinename),
	reprintcounter=0,
	SrBufferInvCode=dbo.srbufferledger.SRBufferInvCode,
	InvTotal = dbo.srbufferledger.InvTotal,
	altersaleinvcode= dbo.saleledger.altersaleinvcode,
	associatedamt= 0.00,
	serverdate=getdate()
FROM 
	dbo.saleledger,
	dbo.srbufferledger,   
	dbo.srbufferdetail,  
	item,
	Users 
WHERE 
	( dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode = :ra_InvCode ) AND
	( dbo.saleledger.srbufferinvcode = dbo.srbufferLedger.srbufferinvcode ) AND
	( dbo.srbufferledger.srbufferinvcode = dbo.srbufferdetail.srbufferinvcode ) AND 
	( dbo.srbufferLedger.SalesManCode = users.userCode ) and
	( dbo.srbufferdetail.icode = item.icode )
GROUP BY 
	dbo.srbufferledger.srbufferinvcode,
	dbo.srbufferledger.saleinvcode, 
	dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode,
	srbufferledger.date, 
	srbufferledger.custcode, 
	srbufferledger.discperc, 
	srbufferledger.flatdisc, 
	srbufferledger.misccharges, 
	srbufferledger.headerno,
	srbufferledger.salestax, 
	srbufferledger.remarks, 
	srbufferdetail.icode,
	srbufferdetail.gcode, 
	dbo.srbufferledger.InvTotal,
	dbo.saleledger.altersaleinvcode,
	saleledger.cashtendered,
	saleledger.cashcharged,
	saleledger.cashback,
	item.icode,
	item.printable,
	item.customicode,
	users.username
ORDER BY 
	SaleType,
	ID

objects.name: compute_12
objects.visible: 1	if( Sum(saletype for all distinct saletype )=1, 0,1)
objects.expression: Round(Sum (if(saletype=1, 1, -1) *  invtotal for all distinct saletype ), 0)

objects.name: t_5
objects.visible: 1	if( Sum(saletype for all distinct saletype )=1, 0,1)

objects.name: compute_1
objects.expression: if(Round(Sum (if(saletype=1, 1, -1) *  invtotal for all distinct saletype ), 0) < 0, cashreceived + cardscharged + Round(Sum (if(saletype=1, 1, -1) *  invtotal for all distinct saletype ), 0), cashreceived + cardscharged - Round(Sum (if(saletype=1, 1, -1) *  invtotal for all distinct saletype ), 0))

objects.name: compute_4
objects.visible: 1	/*if(( looseqty * itemflatdisc ) + ( looseqty * ( saledetail_saleprice - itemflatdisc ) *  saledetail_discperc  * 0.01)=0,0,1)*/ if((saledetail_discperc + itemflatdisc)=0,0,1)
objects.expression: ( looseqty * itemflatdisc ) + ( looseqty * ( saledetail_saleprice - itemflatdisc ) *  saledetail_discperc  * 0.01)

objects.name: c_grosstotal
objects.expression: Sum (  c_amount for group 1 )  + sum( associatedamt for group 1)

objects.name: c_nettotal
objects.expression: Round(Sum (  c_netamount for group 1) -  saleledger_flatdisc  +  saleledger_misccharges  + saleledger_salestax , 0)
